nodes.label: Domain Analyser Data Refresh Mechanism
nodes.rationale: the analyser doesn't query graph for the domain list directly, it reads cipp's cached tenant data then runs its own dns lookups; a domain has to reach the cache before the analyser can see it and re-running the analysis won't pull in a domain the cache hasn't collected yet

nodes.label: Domain Analyser Excluded Domains
nodes.rationale: microsoft and known cloud signature/voice provider domains are never analysed since their dns records are outside your control; the same exclusions apply to the Add DKIM standard
